title: IVG Intense Salts Blue Raspberry 10ml Nic Salts E-Liquid
description: IVG Intense Salts Blue Raspberry recreates the sweet, syrupy taste of the classic Blue Raspberry flavour. Blending the tang of Raspberries with the rounded sweetness of Blueberry notes, it delivers a confectionery-inspired berry mix that’s distinctive and moreish. This e-liquid is blended at a 50VG/50PG ratio for smooth flavour delivery, discreet vapour, and a tactile yet comfortable throat hit. Available in 10mg and 20mg Nic Salt strengths, it’s well suited to mouth-to-lung (MTL) pod kits, starter kits and vape pens. As part of the IVG Intense Salts range, Blue Raspberry offers a playful, flavour-packed profile in a convenient Nic Salt format, perfect for those who enjoy sweeter berry blends.
